title: Ratios and Sharing
summary: Comparing quantities with ratios, equivalent ratios, sharing in a ratio, and map scales.

cbse.chapter: Ganita Prakash Part 2 Ch 3: Proportional Reasoning-2

objectives: I can write and simplify ratios.
I can share an amount in a given ratio.
I can use ratios in real contexts like mixing and map scales.
misconceptions: Sharing in 2 : 3 gives 2 and 3 of the money.
A ratio tells you the actual amounts.
